company.shortDescription: Basalt is a research and development firm that is involved in the research and development of basalt fiber and improving the basalt fiber.
company.description:
Basalt creates a public interest industry for a secure and affluent future society. The company conducts research on characteristics of minerals and contribute to the development of human society through the development of environmentally friendly new materials. The company focuses on research and development of basalt fiber and the importing and sale of basalt primary processed products.

Basalt was founded in November 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
